caption:
On a flat white surface, a left hand grips a reflective metallic spherical puzzle ball marked by a seam, while a loose scatter of small metallic jigsaw pieces lies near the center. A right hand, palm up, holds several of the same pieces and lets them slip off one after another onto the central pile, thinning the handful until a single piece rests on the open palm.

The right hand then pinches that last piece between its fingers, moves it briefly above the scatter, and drops it onto the pile. With the handful now empty, the right hand withdraws toward the top-right and is gone, leaving only the left hand and the sphere. The central scatter of metallic pieces remains mostly still after the additions.

The left hand keeps its grip on the sphere but slowly turns it, shifting the seam across the reflective surface. As the ball rotates, the surface reveals metallic puzzle pieces attached to it together with empty gaps where pieces are missing. Bright highlights and the hand's reflection shift across the chrome as it turns. The sphere stays in roughly the same left-side position throughout.
